bc.title: Checking your browser
bc.lede: Before opening your emails, we look for signs that someone is reading this page along with you.
bc.label.framed: Page opened directly, not inside another
bc.label.injected: No outside code on the page
bc.warnTitle: Something may be reading this page
bc.warnLede: We found signs of outside code running alongside Shalom. It can see your emails once they are open on screen.
bc.advice: Safest option: open a private window with no extensions, or turn off extensions for shalomail.com and check again.
bc.remember: I trust this. Don't warn me again on this device.
bc.limit: The check sees what runs inside this page. A program installed on the computer that records the whole screen doesn't show up here.
bc.insecure: The connection to Shalom is not secure.
bc.inFrame: Shalom is open inside another page.
bc.webdriver: The browser reports that a program is controlling it.
bc.replacedHint: This is usually an extension or antivirus that inspects pages.
bc.inlineScript: Script written directly into the page
bc.style: Style added to the page from outside
bc.blockedExt: Blocked attempt to load extension code
bc.blockedInline: Blocked attempt to run code on the page
bc.ext.colorzilla: Color picker. Runs on every page waiting for its eyedropper shortcut and, with that access, can see what appears on screen.
bc.ext.grammarly: Writing checker. Reads what you type and sends it to Grammarly’s servers to correct it.
bc.ext.darkreader: Dark mode for websites. Reads the whole page to change its colors, on your own device.
bc.ext.languagetool: Writing checker. Reads what you type and sends it to LanguageTool’s servers to correct it.
bc.ext.loom: Screen and camera recorder. It can record what appears on screen.
bc.ext.honey: Discount coupons. Reads the pages you open to find stores.
bc.ext.unknown: We couldn’t tell which one it is from the sign it left, but it runs on this page and can see the screen.
